buildCommand: bash -c 'export PATH="$PATH:$HOME/flutter/bin"; if [ ! -d "$HOME/flutter" ]; then git clone --depth 1 -b 3.38.9 https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git "$HOME/flutter" || exit 1; fi; flutter config --no-analytics || true; flutter pub get && flutter build web --release --dart-define=API_BASE_URL=https://api.tvrfy.co.ke'
